description: Timed on-chain arcade memory game with provably fair TEE-generated colour sequences. Pay a small GAS entry, choose a mode, watch the glowing pattern revealed inside a Morpheus TEE session, and repeat it from memory before the deadline. One wrong press ends the run. Win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Pulse Arcade (8 cues), 0.5 for Neon Rush (12), 1 for Master Circuit (16). The full sequence never leaves the enclave — only the next colour is revealed after each round you complete. Winnings accrue as withdrawable credit and every solve is ranked on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 限时链上街机记忆游戏，颜色序列由 TEE 保证可验证公平。支付少量 GAS 报名费，选择模式，观看 Morpheus TEE 会话中揭示的发光序列，并在截止时间前凭记忆复现。按错一次即结束。达到目标即赢取固定 GAS 奖励：脉冲街机 0.1（8 个灯号）、霓虹连击 0.5（12）、冠军序列 1（16）。完整序列永不离开飞地——每完成一轮才揭示下一种颜色。奖金以可提取余额累计，每次通关都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: The colour sequence is generated inside a Morpheus TEE enclave from a deterministic per-game secret. Only its hash commitment is bound on-chain at the start; the enclave reveals just the next colour after each completed round, so the full future is never handed to the client. At settlement the TEE replays the recorded presses, applies a behavioural timing gate, and signs the achieved sequence length after checking the commitment.

tee.description: The play session is verified by Morpheus TEE compute before settlement, with the contract bound to the configured Morpheus oracle kernel on testnet.
